verdict.rationale: Kick's Bill Pay tab gives a live view of outstanding bills, AP aging, and vendor balances. That data is synced from Ramp or BILL, so it depends on those third-party integrations, and AP sits on the Plus plan. The docs describe only a live, current view, with nothing showing AP aging or vendor balances as of a historical date. Missing for 10: as-of/historical AP aging and vendor balance reporting, native AP without Ramp/BILL, independent or hands-on corroboration.
